verdict.rationale: A national company registry could plausibly offer headless or API-driven filing and lookup for CI automation, so this axis applies. The evidence pack shows only HTTP 403 responses at robots.txt for mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, and nothing documents a headless mode, API, or CLI usable from CI. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
